bindings.caption: Acquire the fluorescence time trace. Continuous-wave excitation and sCMOS recording. Exposure and frame rate are separate source settings; absent per-panel quantities are not inferred. Illustration is an instrument/action cue, not a simulated experimental trace. The common method uses a Nikon Si-oil immersion objective, Hamamatsu C5440-20UP sCMOS camera and ET500LP emission filter. The general camera rate is 30 fps; per-panel frame rates are only asserted where explicitly reported. Qualified action illustration; no unreported vessel dimensions, hardware, measured molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.
